items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: he lives right next door to Paul Barberand

ctx.x: I see. Is that why I can't find you in the phone book?

Well, no, we're listed in the phone book, not the manual cell. We're listed under my deceased father George's cell. Oh, I see. And I have a brother, Joe's cell, who's listed in the phone book, but he lives up on Franklin Street. He don't play music, he's a painter by Trey. And I have another brother, George's cell, but he's listed under his wife, Maiden, who lives on St. Anthony, and he lives right next door to Paul Barberand.
